digest.component_or_area: S2 CLI parser and route registry
propositions: Registry construction and route lookup must not import handlers or optional dependencies, verified by subprocess isolation tests.
Factory protocol and ArgumentParser customization must produce deterministic formatted help text and parse errors without process termination.
Route records must represent every current command spelling (including legacy/retired variants) and derive compatibility policy exports with zero delta from legacy sets.
Registry validation must reject duplicate spellings, alias/retired collisions, contradictory policies, unknown capability IDs, and malformed references deterministically.
Retired routes must be excluded from shipped ROUTES table and derived exports while validation and composition mechanisms remain exercisable on synthetic test routes.
